synthesis: A 100M+ public painting sale occurred within the forecast window (Klimt Lederer, 236.4M, Nov 2025), reinforcing a high likelihood of at least one such sale before May 1, 2026. Given precedent and the realized threshold, the probability should be raised from the ensemble estimate; the adjusted probability reflects this realized data with a tight upper bound.
